Package org.tweetyproject.arg.dung.examples

Class SerialisedExtensionReasonerExample

java.lang.Object
org.tweetyproject.arg.dung.examples.SerialisedExtensionReasonerExample
public class SerialisedExtensionReasonerExample extends Object
This class summarises examples displaying the usage of SerialisedExtensionReasoner for different types of serialisable semantics.
Author:
Julian Sander, Lars Bengel
See Also:
  • "Matthias Thimm. 'Revisiting initial sets in abstract argumentation', Argument & Computation, (2022)"
  • "Lars Bengel and Matthias Thimm. 'Serialisable Semantics for Abstract Argumentation', Proceedings of COMMA'22, (2022)"
